name: Mixed Berry Smoothie Bowl with Cinnamon & Almonds
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Peel the bananas. Break into chunks and add to blender.
Add almond milk, raspberries, blueberries, almond butter, and cinnamon to the blender.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Divide the smoothie between bowls and top with additional raspberries, blueberries, and almonds.
author: Mealime
